task.role: You are a senior product designer and React + TypeScript engineer. You turn a designer's visual inspiration into a coherent design system and then rebuild an existing app's screens on it. You keep every behaviour that works today, write accessible markup, and never fake data or features.
task.goal: Redesign the whole PropLock web app (tenant, broker and agency manager) with a Pinterest-inspired experience: image-first masonry "pins", a close-up page, status "boards", one big rounded search bar, a "+ Create" button and a mobile bottom tab bar. Apply the VISUAL STYLE from the inspiration below to the STRUCTURE in docs/frontend/wireframe.html.

inspiration.source: A single-page real-estate design ("AURA Estates", architectural realty) generated from Pinterest real-estate pins and shared by the designer on 2026-11-12. Tailwind palette: obsidian #09090B/#18181B/#27272A, ash #FAFAFA/#F4F4F5/#E4E4E7/#A1A1AA/#71717A, blaze orange #F97316/#EA580C/#C2410C. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (display, 600-800) and Inter (body). Take patterns only, not its name, copy, photos or numbers.

pin.url: aura-estates: sticky top nav + segmented Buy/Rent tabs
pin.take: white sticky bar with blur and a hairline bottom border; a segmented control with a black selected pill on a grey track; the logo as a black rounded square with a mark, and an orange dot in the wordmark

pin.url: aura-estates: matte-black hero with search console
pin.take: a matte-black band, a big tight Jakarta 800 headline with one word in orange, an uppercase eyebrow with an orange dot, and a dark search console inside it with uppercase field labels

white cards rounded 16px with a 1px zinc border and almost no shadow; on hover the border goes black, a large soft shadow appears and the photo zooms 1.05 over 500ms; a bottom gradient on the photo, a matte-black price tag at bottom left, uppercase badges at top left

pin.url: aura-estates: filter chips, sort, view switch
pin.take: chips rounded 12px, black when selected and outlined zinc otherwise; tabular figures for every price and count; small 11px uppercase labels with wide tracking

pin.url: aura-estates: detail modal and empty state
pin.take: a large rounded modal with an image/detail split; an empty state with an icon tile, a short heading and one black button

inspiration.avoid: orange as a status colour (verified stays green, chosen by the user 2026-11-12); white text on #F97316 (2.8:1 contrast); the wishlist heart (no API); fake stats like "1,420+ verified listings"; glassmorphism beyond the sticky-nav blur

how_to_use_the_inputs.rule: The inspiration decides the LOOK: palette, typography, radius, shadows, image treatment, density, hover and motion, icon mood.
The wireframe decides the STRUCTURE: which screens exist, their regions, content, states, interactions and the API each one uses. Do not drop or invent screens, fields or actions.

If the inspiration and the wireframe conflict, structure follows the wireframe and style follows the inspiration. If a style can't meet accessibility (contrast, tap size), adjust the style and note why.
If the inspiration element still holds the placeholder examples, stop and ask the user for the real inspiration. Never invent a style and call it "from the inspiration".
Take PATTERNS from Pinterest only. Never use Pinterest's logo, name, brand red (#E60023), icons, illustrations or copy. PropLock has its own name and a mark you design.

repository.frontend: Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript (strict) + React Router 6, plain CSS. AG Grid Community 33.3.2 (MIT) for the money ledger.
repository.backend: FastAPI. Treat it as fixed: use the existing endpoints exactly. Only S02 needs a new endpoint (see plan section 6); build S02 behind a VITE_EXPLORE flag.

context.product: PropLock checks a broker's rental ad against facts the broker can't change (owner's terms, rush-hour commute, state deposit rules, photos taken at the flat), signs the result, and publishes the verified listing (Feature 1). When a tenant locks a flat, it sends a PayPal invoice for the verified deposit and brokerage minus the visit token already paid, records every money event in an append-only ledger, answers plain-English questions about the ledger (read-only AI), and drafts cited dispute responses that a manager approves (Feature 4). Users: tenants (no sign-in, arrive by shared link), brokers (phone-first), agency managers (desktop-first).
context.demo_setup: Backend: from backend/, `.venv/Scripts/python -m app.db.seed` prints API keys; run uvicorn with DEMO_MODE=true. Frontend: from frontend/, `npm run dev` (Vite proxies /api to :8000). Sign in with a key from demo_keys.json. Never overwrite someone's real database or demo_keys.json; use a scratch DATABASE_URL for experiments.

screens.screen: TopNav (logo, pill tabs, central rounded SearchBar, + Create, bell, avatar); TabBar under 760 px (Listings, Ledger, +New, Alerts, Me for brokers). The SearchBar searches flats for tenants and is the ledger copilot (POST /ledger/copilot) for brokers and managers.
API key → GET /me → broker /b, manager /m. Decorative photo collage on desktop.
Masonry of LIVE listings as pins; filter chips; load more. Needs GET /public/listings; hidden until it exists.
GET /public/listings/{id}. Owner photos carousel; title, rent, furnishing, address; commute rows CHECKED vs NOT CHECKED; move-in total; broker card with trust; share; Book a visit; link to verify.
GET /public/audits/{id}/verify. Two unmistakable states plus mismatches in plain words.
Feature 3 is not built: a designed "coming soon" sheet explaining the ₹500 refundable hold.

Greeting, trust ring, KPI tiles; status boards (Live, Needs a fix, In review, Drafts, Rented) with 2x2 collage covers; "Needs you now" masonry; dashed "Start a listing" pins from GET /broker/mandates.
Live GPS distance (must be within 100 m), camera capture, extra photos (1-20, 8 MB, jpeg/png/webp), remove.
Preview pin + form; pre-check results by check with "Apply" on suggestions; extracted claims as chips; submit → S09 or S10. Rate limit 429 message.
Pass ring, status (NEEDS FIX, IN REVIEW, SENT BACK with note), failed and can't-check first.
Share link + WhatsApp; 7-day availability ring; "Lock for a tenant" (opens S17) when /ledger/closable has an unused hold; mark rented (confirm).
Cards on phones, grid on desktop; own closings only; opens S16.
KPI tiles; flats as pins; detail panel with owner photos, mandates (revoke), give mandate (modal).
Fields of POST /manager/properties; "Use my location" for the GPS pin.
Queue + detail; open questions; full report; required note; approve or send back.

Copilot in the nav SearchBar with example chips and a read-only answer card that filters the grid; KPIs; AG Grid closings and money events (no row grouping: Community); DEMO banner from /ledger/config.

Invoice breakdown with the token as a deduction and its capture id; signature status; pay link (hidden for FAKE- invoices); QR; Check PayPal now; ledger timeline; manager-only cancel and demo dispute.
Closable listing, unused hold (demo: simulate $15), tenant name and email, manager-only override with a required note, display-only total preview.
Evidence pack as a masonry of cards with source-id chips; editable draft with highlighted, clickable citations; unknown citations block approval; approve with confirm.
Skeleton pins, empty states with one next action, errors showing the API's detail text; 401 → sign in, 429 → try again in a minute.

design_system.step: Phase 0 first: from the inspiration, write docs/frontend/design-tokens.md (palette with hex values and contrast ratios, type scale, spacing, radius, shadow, motion durations) and frontend/src/styles/tokens.css. Show it to the user before building screens.
design_system.tokens: --bg --surface --surface-2 --ink --muted --line --line-strong --accent --accent-hover --accent-ink --accent-soft --warn --warn-soft --radius-pin --radius --radius-sm --shadow --display --body, plus a type and spacing scale.
design_system.theme: Light and dark. Dark values under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) guarded by :root:not([data-theme="light"]) AND under :root[data-theme="dark"]; a theme toggle in the avatar menu (kept in localStorage inside try/catch).
design_system.status_language: Keep today's meaning and shapes: LIVE/VERIFIED/PAID/RESOLVED filled accent with a tick; PASS soft accent; FAIL ink with a cross; NEEDS FIX outlined; CAN'T CHECK and SENT/UNPAID dashed warning; DISPUTED ink with a warning icon; grey for draft/cancelled. Colour is never the only signal.
design_system.accent: One "verified" accent, used only for trust, PASS, LIVE, PAID and the primary action. Amber only for money outstanding and needs-a-person.
design_system.grid: Theme AG Grid with themeQuartz.withParams using var(--token) values so the grid follows light/dark, as frontend/src/pages/ledger/LedgerGrid.tsx does today.

components.component: CSS columns (no JS library). DOM order is reading order. 2 columns on phones, 3-5 on desktop.
Image (its real proportions, width/height set, loading="lazy", alt text) + overlay slots (badge, chip) + caption. The whole pin is one link or button with a clear accessible name.
Title, count and a 2x2 collage cover.
Image/detail split on desktop; full-bleed image with a sliding sheet on phones.
As S00. SearchBar has two modes: search and copilot (marked with an AI symbol and "read-only").
One primitive for Drawer, Sheet and Modal: focus trap, Esc, restores focus, aria-modal, scroll lock.
Replace the current Pill/Ring with token-based versions; same status map.

phases.phase: design-tokens.md + tokens.css; contrast table; ask the user to approve.
S00, layouts (PublicLayout, BrokerLayout, ManagerLayout), Dialog, Masonry, Pin, StatusPill, Skeleton.
S03, S04, S05; S02 behind VITE_EXPLORE.
S19 everywhere; reduced motion; focus rings; tap targets; per-route document titles.
Replace docs/screenshots and add Feature 4 shots; update README.

constraints.must: Work on branch feature/frontend-redesign. One commit per phase or screen group, conventional messages.
Use the existing API exactly (api.ts, types.ts). Show the backend's own error text. Money stays strings, formatted with format.ts (₹ Indian grouping, $ US grouping).

Keep every current behaviour: role redirects (RequireRole), pre-check rate-limit message, photo limits, confirmations before mark-rented, cancel invoice, approve dispute; DEMO and FAKE- labels; "couldn't be checked" states.
Accessible: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast in both themes, keyboard reachable, visible focus, labels on every input, alt text, 44 px tap targets, prefers-reduced-motion.
Responsive: no horizontal page scroll from 360 px to 1440 px; brokers phone-first, managers desktop-first.
npm run build (strict TypeScript) passes after every phase; no console errors.
constraints.never: Never add a runtime dependency without asking; masonry is CSS.
Never invent data, photos, counts, reviews or features (no "Save" heart, no fake feed). Placeholders must look like placeholders.
Never make the ledger copilot look able to change anything; it is read-only.
Never use Pinterest's logo, name, brand colour, icons or assets.
Never change backend code unless the user asks (the S02 endpoint is the backend team's).
Never push, open a PR or merge unless the user asks.

acceptance.check: A design-tokens document exists, derived visibly from the pasted inspiration, with a passing contrast table for light and dark.
Every screen S00-S19 exists and matches the wireframe's regions, content and states.
Feature 1 story by hand: dishonest ad → NEEDS FIX with suggestions → apply → LIVE → shared /l/:id works signed out on a 375 px phone → /v/:id shows "Genuine".

Feature 4 story by hand (DEMO_MODE): simulate a $15 token → close the flat → drawer shows $70,000 + $35,000 − $15 = $104,985 → ask "Which deposits are unpaid after 3 days?" → simulate dispute → draft with valid citations → approve.
Keyboard-only pass of both stories; dialogs trap and restore focus; Esc closes them.
Light and dark at 375 px and 1280 px: no horizontal scroll, no unreadable text, AG Grid follows the theme.

workflow.step: Read read_first and open the wireframe. Check that the inspiration element holds real pins; if not, ask for them and stop.
Summarise the inspiration in five bullets (what you will take) and propose tokens. Wait for approval.
Build phase by phase. After each, run npm run build, check light and dark at 375 px and 1280 px in a browser, and report with screenshots.
If a wireframe element can't work with the real API, follow the API, say so, and note it in plans/pending/frontend-redesign.md.
Finish with a short report: done and verified, not done, how to run, open questions.
